name: HuntForge
description: Techniques covered by the rules in this repository.

techniques.comment: PowerShell script block with in-memory execution or encoded payload
Successful AWS console login without MFA
Administrator policy attached to an IAM principal
Failed network logon for a non-existent account
Volume shadow copy deletion (ransomware recovery inhibition)
Windows service installed from a user-writable path
Microsoft Defender real-time protection or scanning disabled
CloudTrail logging stopped, deleted or reconfigured
Outbound connection from a known reverse-shell binary
